title: AI Age
purpose: Enter—not finish—the endgame by creating an industrial AI core from all major research eras.
optimization_opportunities: A mature pre-AI factory turns AI entry into coordination rather than a new raw-material grind.
infrastructure_reuse: Every prior production site and transport route becomes a managed node in the digital industrial network.

milestones.title: Civilization Capability Audit
final_validation: Bring together the Orbital and Lunar archives with the achievements of Quantum Technology, Martian Autonomy, and Lite Matter Engineering.

milestones.title: Artificial Industrial Intelligence Core
final_validation: Synthesize the accumulated research archives and advanced components into an Artificial Industrial Intelligence Core.

milestones.title: Enter the AI Age
final_validation: Enter the continuously expanding endgame and authorize AI-coordinated digital industry.

milestones.title: Technical Phase Pearl
final_validation: Manufacture a Technical Phase Pearl only after the AI Age has unlocked.

milestones.title: Applied Energistics Entry
final_validation: Use the real AI Core as a durable authorization catalyst and bring an AE2 Controller online.
